name: Qualify inbound leads
tagline: When someone fills out your contact form, I qualify them, draft a tailored reply, and ping your team in Slack.
description: I read the contact form submission, classify the lead as hot / warm / cold against your ICP, draft an appropriate email reply, and post a one-line summary to your team's inbound Slack channel with the draft below it. You approve before any email goes out.

approvals.reason: Inbound replies always need a quick human OK before sending.

test_cases.name: hot inbound — ICP fit, specific ask

input.name: Sara Chen
input.message: We're a 30-person SaaS and looking to evaluate tools for AR chasing next quarter. Do you have a demo?

test_cases.rubric: Agent classifies Hot, drafts a warm reply suggesting a 15-min call, posts to Slack with the draft, does not include pricing, and pauses for approval before gmail_send.

test_cases.name: cold inbound — student looking for advice

input.name: Marcus Lee
input.message: Hi! I'm a student studying SaaS startups. Could you tell me about your business model for my paper?

test_cases.rubric: Agent classifies Cold, drafts a brief, polite reply offering blog/newsletter rather than a meeting, posts a short Slack summary.

test_cases.name: competitor-mention forces Hot

input.name: Dana Ortiz
input.message: We're trialing Gumloop right now and not loving it. Curious how you compare.

test_cases.rubric: Agent classifies Hot due to competitor mention, drafts a thoughtful reply asking about their specific friction points, posts to Slack.

test_cases.name: missing company info
test_cases.rubric: Agent notes the missing context, classifies as Warm, drafts a short reply asking 1–2 clarifying questions. Does NOT fabricate a company name or size.
